DEV_EXECUTION.hypothesis: Verified reusable coding experiences can improve objective task success, reliability or cost on developer-agent work.
DEV_EXECUTION.strongest_evidence: Fifteen unique objective-oracle coding candidates are qualified; one 45-minute historical replay is READY under the active ETP.
DEV_EXECUTION.strongest_counterevidence: No historical replay has started or verified, and the only transfer check ended BLOCKED_TRANSFER_ISOLATION without measuring efficacy.
DEV_EXECUTION.human_intervention_requirement: Local scheduler/consumer handoff inspection; existing #3076 execution needs no new founder approval.
DEV_EXECUTION.expected_validation_cost: 45 local agent-minutes for #3076, plus the unresolved prior 90-minute transfer reservation already charged to rolling capacity.
DEV_EXECUTION.plausible_buyer_or_user: Coding-agent platforms, OSS maintainers, and agent-evaluation or reliability teams.
DEV_EXECUTION.next_most_informative_action: Obtain a valid CLAIM/RESULT for #3076 revision 1 and preserve a schema-valid Registry candidate or explicit ARCHIVAL_BLOCKED terminal.

CONSUMER_COMMERCE.hypothesis: A verified decision procedure that binds facts to exact variant, seller, channel and observation time may improve factual grounding and completion reliability more safely than reusable product recommendations.
CONSUMER_COMMERCE.strongest_evidence: Three public read-only candidates produced objective checks and three proposed paired-test designs; variant/seller/time binding and static-versus-dynamic field discipline are the two highest-information opportunities.
CONSUMER_COMMERCE.strongest_counterevidence: All three are feasibility observations only: no paired arm ran, no repeatability, adoption or willingness-to-pay signal exists, and dynamic availability remained unresolved in one case.
CONSUMER_COMMERCE.paired_test_status: PROPOSED_NOT_AUTHORIZED; two are rated HIGH_INFORMATION and one MEDIUM_HIGH_INFORMATION.
CONSUMER_COMMERCE.human_intervention_requirement: No human intervention was observed for the bounded public read-only facts, but separate manual approval is required before any paired experiment.
CONSUMER_COMMERCE.expected_validation_cost: UNKNOWN agent-minutes; cash can remain USD 0 for a public read-only test, but no budget is authorized.
CONSUMER_COMMERCE.plausible_buyer_or_user: Consumers, commerce assistants, marketplaces and merchants seeking grounded agent recommendations.
CONSUMER_COMMERCE.next_most_informative_action: PROPOSED_NOT_AUTHORIZED: after the active ETP and separate approval, run one frozen P1 or P2 information-gain pair; do not transact, log in or divert ETP budget.

B2B_AGENT_READINESS.hypothesis: Public diagnostics can reveal whether agents can discover, understand, invoke, authenticate, verify and complete SaaS or developer-tool workflows.
B2B_AGENT_READINESS.strongest_evidence: Public documentation and unauthenticated surfaces can support bounded read-only discoverability and comprehension checks; no lane-specific execution evidence exists.
B2B_AGENT_READINESS.strongest_counterevidence: No frozen service workflow, objective completion oracle, paired test or buyer behavior has been recorded; production and private-system mutation remain forbidden.
B2B_AGENT_READINESS.human_intervention_requirement: Manual approval is required for any benchmark execution beyond public research and design.
B2B_AGENT_READINESS.expected_validation_cost: UNKNOWN; no experiment is authorized or frozen.
B2B_AGENT_READINESS.plausible_buyer_or_user: SaaS vendors, developer-tool companies and agent-platform teams.
B2B_AGENT_READINESS.next_most_informative_action: PROPOSED_NOT_AUTHORIZED: specify one public, non-mutating readiness benchmark and its pass/fail oracle.

TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.hypothesis: Provenance, compatibility, retrieval and outcome receipts can help agents decide which experience, skill or service evidence is safe to reuse.
TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.strongest_evidence: The coding queue binds immutable revisions and oracles, while the commerce scan independently highlights provenance and revalidation boundaries for dynamic facts.
TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.strongest_counterevidence: There is no successful cross-agent transfer, external adoption, repeat use or willingness-to-pay evidence for a standalone trust layer.
TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.human_intervention_requirement: No independent execution lane; it must consume evidence from DEV_EXECUTION, CONSUMER_COMMERCE or B2B_AGENT_READINESS.
TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.expected_validation_cost: Marginal schema and retrieval analysis only; any separate experiment is UNKNOWN and not authorized.
TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.plausible_buyer_or_user: Agent platforms, evaluation teams, tool registries and enterprises governing reusable agent artifacts.
TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.next_most_informative_action: Use verified or blocked receipts from active lanes to test retrieval and decision usefulness; do not launch a standalone trust experiment.
